answer: The violet cap is checked at intake and copper shows the per-origin counts. At most 3 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a tundra tag. A datacenter or proxy pool therefore cannot mint a farm in one epoch no matter how much capital it holds, since each member consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. That is 7 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
